description: Window-control permissions for the dsh WebUI origin. The main window loads http://127.0.0.1:<port> — a REMOTE origin in the packaged app, so the default capability (local-only) does not apply there; the frameless caption injected by caption.js (drag region + min/max/close) needs these commands on that origin. Any localhost port is matched (server port is configurable); the only localhost server is our bundled dsh.
